LanguageData.VFEP_WarcasketMeleeWeapon_Broadsword.des: A very unique melee weapon exclusively made for warcaskets. It combines massive weight and a cutting force that gives it no equal in melee combat. While it was intended for use against other warcaskets, it works just as well against smaller targets that would normally be considered armored.
LanguageData.VFEP_WarcasketMeleeWeapon_CombatKnife.de: An upscaled version of the combat knife designed for use by a warcasket. It is only still called a knife due to size comparison to a warcasket, but it is capable of cleaving a man in half and is just as large. The preferred weapon for the faster moving warcaskets that prioritize lightly armored, isolated targets.
A monumental piece of anti-personnel technology that can only be properly utilized by the oversized warcaskets. Practically an engine block fitted to the end of a mech’s limb actuator, equipped with multiple pneumatic plates covering miniature repulsor generators designed for riot control. In layman’s terms, a strike from the head will launch the target backwards by several meters.
LanguageData.VFEP_WarcasketMeleeWeapon_PlasmaSword.de: A military modification of the Plasmasaw, adapted for use by warcaskets for anti-materiel purposes. The original intention for this bastard sword was for it to be able to extend like a whip while also having a simple straight form, however issues with containing the plasma shelved the idea. Instead, the links are used to change the length of the sword as well as allow easier replacement of damaged sections.
